2607.08754.title: SLORR: Simple and Efficient In-Training Low-Rank Regularization
2607.08754.paper_summary: Low-rank factorization is widely used to compress neural networks, but modern models are often not naturally amenable to aggressive factorization without significant accuracy loss. Existing training-time low-rank regularizers can improve compressibility, but they often require SVDs of large weight matrices, modify the model architecture (introducing additional trainable parameters), or rely on stateful cached quantities. To address these limitations, we introduce SLORR, a simple, stateless, and architecture-preserving framework for in-training low-rank regularization, instantiated with two main variants based on the Hoyer sparsity metric and the nuclear norm. SLORR directly regularizes the original weight matrices using GPU-friendly approximations for the forward and backward passes of the regularizers, for which we provide approximation guarantees. We first evaluate SLORR on ImageNet-1K across short-horizon continued training of ResNet-50, ViT-B/16, and ViT-L/16, and pretraining of ResNet-18, where SLORR induces compressibility while introducing less than 8% training overhead. We further evaluate SLORR-Hoyer in LLM pretraining at 135M and 560M scales: SLORR-trained compressed models preserve performance substantially better than unregularized models while adding less than 1% average training overhead.
2607.08754.paper_summary_zh: 低秩分解被廣泛用於壓縮神經網絡，但現代模型通常不自然適合於激進的分解，否則會顯著損失準確性。現有的訓練時低秩正則化器可以改善可壓縮性，但它們通常需要對大型權重矩陣進行奇異值分解（SVD），修改模型架構（引入額外的可訓練參數），或依賴有狀態的緩存量。為了解決這些限制，我們引入了SLORR，一個簡單、無狀態且保持架構的訓練時低秩正則化框架，基於Hoyer稀疏度度量和核範數實現了兩個主要變體。SLORR直接使用對GPU友好的近似方法對原始權重矩陣進行正則化，以適應正則化器的前向和反向傳播，我們為此提供了近似保證。我們首先在ImageNet-1K上評估SLORR，進行ResNet-50、ViT-B/16和ViT-L/16的短期持續訓練，以及ResNet-18的預訓練，其中SLORR促進了可壓縮性，同時引入的訓練開銷少於8%。我們進一步在135M和560M規模的LLM預訓練中評估SLORR-Hoyer：SLORR訓練的壓縮模型在性能上顯著優於未正則化的模型，同時平均訓練開銷少於1%。
2607.08754.author: David González-Martínez et.al.
